policies.identity: 196 identities do not mean 196 independently painted atlases. Current recipe families are shared and composed.
policies.evidence: Recipe presence, actual resolver casts, successful publication, player dispatch and browser observations are separate layers.
policies.authority: Preserve each event source. deterministic-projection is not promoted to committed-combat.
policies.coverage: A passing common adapter test does not count as every skill or every battle mode having been observed.
policies.missing: No evidence means not individually verified, not an assertion that the feature is broken.
policies.planning: Planned awakening skills and passive/support modifiers are excluded from implemented cast counts.
